description: This file defines a role selector engine for accessibility testing, including functions for validating role attributes, querying elements by ARIA roles, and creating a selector engine.

methods.name: validateSupportedRole
methods.description: Validates if a role is supported for a given attribute.

methods.name: validateSupportedValues
methods.description: Checks if attribute value is within allowed values.

methods.name: validateSupportedOp
methods.description: Checks if the operator is supported for the attribute.

methods.name: validateAttributes
methods.description: Validates and constructs role engine options from attribute selectors.

methods.name: queryRole
methods.description: Queries DOM elements matching specified ARIA role and attribute options.
